subject: Request: greenlight backfill + hiring panel logistics for Inference Ops (IC3)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: greenlight backfill + hiring panel logistics for Inference Ops (IC3)

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

We need to open a backfill req for an Inference Ops IC3 to replace Priya (transitioning to a product role at the end of June). Headcount already exists in the org plan but we need hiring-gate approval and a confirmed interview panel before we publish the req to agencies.

Key context:
- Role: Inference Operations Engineer (IC3) — primary focus on model deployment reliability, KV cache debugging, and batch orchestration.
- Reason: backfill / internal move (Priya -> Product).
- Target start of interview loop: week of June 14.

Asks:
1) Marissa — can you approve launching the req and engage our recruiting partners? If possible, publish to agency by 6/2.
2) Aditya — please confirm the interview panel (names below) or suggest alternates.
3) Jonas — confirm we have the budget and slot in the hiring tracker.

Proposed panel:
- Aditya Rao (Hiring Manager)
- Jonas Weber (Platform Lead)
- Kim (me) — system design / ops lens
- One cross-functional reviewer: either Evelyn Hart or Diego Fernandez (TBD)

I attached the draft JD and a simple availability grid for panel members. If you approve, I’ll kick off the agency outreach and set up the first-round calendar poll.

Thanks,
Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Talent Ops (Hiring Partner)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: greenlight backfill + hiring panel logistics for Inference Ops (IC3)

Kim — thanks for the clear ask and doc. Quick questions before I push to agencies:

- Budget: Is this replacement fully within the existing headcount budget (no uplift)?
- Compensation band: please confirm target comp band (IC3 base range).
- Interview loop: do we want a quick take-home (2hr) for first-round or a live take-home? Recruiting prefers a standardized 90-min take-home + 45-min live technical screen.

If budget + band are confirmed, I can open the req today and send to the preferred agency (Taylor Reed) with "priority: standard".

Also, I’ll attach a calendar poll request to coordinate panel availability after Aditya confirms names.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiting Partner, Technical Hiring
Redwood Inference

Budget: confirmed — replacement only, no uplift. Jonas, we routed this through finance during Q2 planning; headcount is allocated to Inference Ops.
Comp band: IC3 target band: $170k–$205k base (total comp varies with equity). Please use the midpoint for offer planning unless candidate is exceptional.
Interview loop: agree with recruiting's recommendation — 90-min take-home + 45-min live tech screen. Keep on-site loop for final round (panel + cross-functional).

Panel notes: I confirm the proposed panel. For the cross-functional reviewer, lean towards Evelyn Hart. She has recent infra experience with customers similar to Acme Robotics.

Aditya

Thanks — this is great.

Marissa: please open the req in Greenhouse (REQ-ACME-7891) and engage Taylor (cc’d) for agency sourcing with the IC3 band and the 90-min take-home + 45-min screen as described. Target to have 4–6 screened candidates by June 18 so we can start scheduling first-round interviews the week of June 21.

Aditya / Jonas: I attached the panel availability grid and a short draft JD. Please add your calendar availability to the poll here: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/8f3b9c.

Sanjay (Acme): appreciate your patience — we’ll share candidate shortlists once they pass the take-home. If you have any hard availability constraints for onsite final interviews in July, let me know and I’ll coordinate.

Next steps (quick):
- Marissa: open req + agency outreach (today)
- Taylor: confirm sourcing timeline and send first slate by 6/14
- Aditya / Jonas: fill poll by EOD Friday 6/4
- Kim: schedule first-round slots once candidates screened

Attaching: job-description-Inference-Ops-IC3.pdf, panel-availability-grid.ics
